answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 40677 Country: Pakistan Title: Name Question: I have a daughter 4 years old , I kept her name Mishael Fatimah (Mishael means Torch). Kindly advise if this name is correct or we need to change this name? Answer ID: 40677 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1269/1269/M=1433) Mash’al (مشعل) means lighting place, flambeau, torch (Firozul Lughat). It does not carry any bad meaning, but as the first part of the name is main and the second part is subsidiary, there is no sign of feminine in Mash’al. Hence it is better to keep only the name Fatimah and if you want to make Mash’al part of the name then add as second part of the name and keep the name as ‘Fatima Mash’al’. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
